---
name: Bug report
about: Something is not synchronised or breaks in a co-op session
labels: bug
---

**What happened** (and what you expected)

**On which copy / who** (host, guest, both; which one did the action)

**How to repeat it** (location in the game, quest/chapter state, steps)

**Setup** (one PC with two copies, or two PCs; network; `-Lite` or not; core build `coopdll_N`)

**Log** (the relevant lines of `coopdll.log` around the time; do not include personal paths or addresses)

**Anything else** (screenshots, how often it happens)
